name: Takatou Nanase
source:
Role: Holy Knight

Nanase is the most influential and the only female executive of the Round Table. She takes active part in guiding the Comunet society newcomers and this makes her quite popular. She doesn't seem to make good use of her appealing breasts in her advocacy for peace.
